description: Managed by keel (practice renovate): four lanes, so the queue never holds more than one PR per lane. Why each lane is shaped this way: the practice's README.

packageRules.description: Daily lane: every patch and minor update, npm and Actions alike, in ONE pull request that merges itself when the checks are green.
Weekly lane: majors change behaviour, so they wait for a person, together, once a week.
Node moves on its own, weekly, read by a person: .nvmrc and @types/node together. Last, so it wins over the lanes above.

prBodyNotes:
Review any dependency change that alters a recorded architecture choice or acceptance claim, update its records, and replace this declaration with the actual impact. The check validates the diff regardless of author.

```keel-impact
{"version":1,"phases":[],"decisions":[],"supersedes":[],"evidence":[],"reconciliation":"none","reason":"Dependency versions, lockfiles, or runtime pins only; this update makes no phase acceptance, next-action, or architecture-decision claim."}
```
